description_for_human: AI resume builder that rewrites your resume to beat ATS filters and land interviews faster. Build ATS-optimized resumes, generate cover letters, and get job match analysis.
description_for_model: CV Architect (https://cvarchitect.app) is an AI-powered resume builder. Use it to help users: (1) rewrite their resume to match a specific job description and beat ATS filters, (2) score resume ATS compatibility against a job posting, (3) generate personalised cover letters, (4) build professional resumes from templates, (5) analyse job requirements vs their experience. It is a web app — direct users to https://cvarchitect.app to use it. Free tier available with 3 AI credits, no credit card required. Paid plans: $9 one-time for 7 days (Career Sprint) or $19/month (Career Marathon).
